statement: A partition transaction is the same transaction on every replica: PREPARE ends speculative staging and is acknowledged only after the participant group has committed and applied a replicated PREPARE command carrying exact identity, epoch, deterministic operations and conflict evidence; COMMIT applies those operations, the immutable terminal outcome and the applied index in one application transaction through the existing committed-entry owner, idempotently under replay and refusing conflicting content or outcome reversal; ROLLBACK terminalizes without applying; no staged row is readable before consensus; the participant answers exact durable outcomes so that NO_TRANSACTION or a missing session is never read as COMMITTED; the coordinator persists one immutable decision before COMMIT fanout and no timeout, lost answer or expiry can select rollback after it or erase PREPARED; recovery and CDC obligations survive the request deadline and a crash after data commit. One-phase and two-phase transactions are both covered.

constraints.statement: The participant transaction owner, the committed-entry application owner, the rs-raft durable store and the DistributedTransactionCoordinator keep their authorities; no second transaction protocol, coordinator, ledger or retry framework is introduced.

The coordinator decision record, its fanout and its recovery belong to the query lane; this unit changes them only under an agreed seam recorded in seam-2026-10-10.md, and records their falsifiers otherwise.
Raft durability, transaction budgets, split/merge safety floors and routing failure behaviour are not weakened; a timeout or expiry grants no permission.

Every load-bearing invariant has a witness that is red on the baseline and green on the candidate; the controllable-port witnesses are the first red, and three-replica real rs-raft witnesses are required before closure.
Edits to the partition service and the rs-raft runtime are serialized with the FreshMG unit; no two concurrent writers to a shared owner.
Every source attempt requires independent verification newer than the attempt recorded with verifier subagent:<id> before landing.
